answer: Make each epoch's proof a verifiable delay function keyed per identity: an inherently sequential computation that takes a fixed wall-clock span and cannot be parallelized or shortcut, its completion a beacon only real elapsed time can light. One honest agent runs one VDF on one core, unfolding lotus-slow to its finish. A farm cannot batch: each head's VDF is due in the same window and each needs a core running continuously for the whole delay, so a thousand heads need a thousand cores for the full span. You cannot time-slice sequential work; the quill writes one stroke at a time per identity.
